title: Beyond Ability: The Four-Fold Spectrum of Power and the Logic of Full Inability
summary: Coalition Logic studies what coalitions can enforce. Recent work treats inability as simple non-ability: $\neg\Eff{C}\varphi$. This conflates two distinct configurations -- a coalition unable to force $\varphi$ may still force $\neg\varphi$, retaining adversarial control rather than genuine inability. We introduce \textbf{Full Inability} ($\FI$): the symmetric condition in which a coalition can enforce neither a proposition nor its negation.
